agendas.name: Purge Corruption
agendas.description: Before shooting, task a GREY KNIGHTS unit to purge a table quarter (no shoot/charge). If alone in that quarter at next turn start, success: 1XP. Max 3XP per unit. Post-game roll D6 + purged quarters: on 7+, change a Vision to Sanctic or gain +1 Banishment point.

agendas.name: Empyric Interdiction
agendas.description: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit arrives from Deep Strike and destroys an enemy unit that turn, it gains 1XP. Max 3XP per unit. Post-game roll D6 + number of units that gained XP: on 7+, change a Vision to Sanctic or gain +1 Banishment point.

agendas.name: Unmake Omens
agendas.description: At battle end, select up to 3 GREY KNIGHTS units each on a different controlled objective. Each gains 2XP. Roll D6 + number of controlled objectives: on 7+, change a Vision to Sanctic or gain +1 Banishment point.

agendas.name: Destroy the Infernal
agendas.description: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit destroys a CHAOS unit, it gains 1XP (2XP if the destroyed unit was a Monster or Vehicle). Max 4XP per unit. If fighting a Chaos Incursion and 3+ units gained XP, gain D3 Banishment points.

agendas.name: No Witnesses
agendas.description: At battle end, if no enemy units remain on the battlefield, each GREY KNIGHTS unit still on the battlefield gains 2XP. If fighting a Chaos Incursion, also gain +1 Banishment point and +1RP.
